---
name: feature idea
about: propose a focused change to the instrument
labels: enhancement
---

## musical task

what are you trying to do, and where does the current instrument get in the way?

## proposed interaction

describe the smallest useful change, including screen space and controls if
relevant. a sketch or short example is welcome; implementation is not required.

## alternatives

can an existing module, routing or workflow already do part of it?

## constraints

mention any effect on Old/New 3DS performance, existing projects, sample memory,
recording or current controls. a proposal is not a promise of implementation.
